content_record.title: Nanomedicine that targets ATP synthase reverses bone aging in mice
content_record.editorial_body: A new class of energy-metabolism-engaged nanomedicines (EM-eNMs) infiltrates mitochondria, triggers fission and mitophagy, and restores stemness in aged bone marrow cells, reversing osteoporotic bone loss in mice. EM-eNMs bind ATP synthase, inducing DRP1-mediated mitochondrial fission. Systemic delivery selectively targets bone, reversing osteoporosis in aged mice. Mechanism parallels caloric restriction, activating mitophagy to clear damaged mitochondria. This signal is based on An energy metabolism-engaged nanomedicine maintains mitochondrial homeostasis to alleviate cellular ageing. from PubMed. Read the original report for full context.
